combo_label: At the Supermarket × Photography × Robin Hood

entries.clue: Three-legged perch that keeps a long night shot rock steady
Perforated strip wound in a canister, ruined by a carelessly opened door
The gold at dead centre of the mark, where Robin split his rival's shaft
Gritty silver texture prized by purists; its digital cousin is noise
Broken jar of pickle glistening on the floor beside a yellow cone
Uniformed watcher near the exit, alert to pockets and unpaid goods
Beggar's rags or a potter's cart, put on to walk into Nottingham unrecognised
Tiny one-serving sleeve of ketchup or sugar, torn at the corner
Cycle of shifts pinned up in the staff room, telling you whose Sunday it is
Open-fronted cabinet for yoghurt and cream, held a few degrees above zero
Dark, poisonous churchyard evergreen whose springy wood armed English archers
Monastic superior outranking a prior, and a stock villain of the old tales
